Phase 3 — Advanced Deep Learning¶

Sketch-to-Face Image Synthesis using pSp (pixel2style2pixel)¶

Track: CNN
Dataset: CelebA-HQ (202,599 images)
Baseline (Phase 2): MLP — Test L1 = 0.4190
Goal: Beat the baseline using a deep CNN-based architecture with principled training upgrades.

Task 1 — Architecture Justification¶

Why pSp (pixel2style2pixel)?¶

The task is paired image-to-image translation (edge map → photorealistic face). The core challenge is that sketches are sparse, high-frequency signals, while faces contain dense, low-frequency texture and identity-specific structure.

Why a CNN encoder over MLP?¶

The MLP baseline (Phase 2, L1=0.4190) treats the image as a flat vector, losing all spatial structure. A CNN encoder processes local receptive fields hierarchically:

  • Stage 1 (stride 2) captures low-level edge direction.
  • Stage 2–3 capture mid-level face components (eyes, nose, lips).
  • Stage 4 captures global face structure (shape, proportions).

This spatial hierarchy is why CNNs dominate image-to-image tasks.

Why W+ latent space (StyleGAN2 decoder)?¶

The StyleGAN2 decoder learns a disentangled, semantically meaningful latent space W+. By mapping sketch features into 18 style codes at different resolutions:

  • Coarse codes (0–3): control global pose and face shape.
  • Medium codes (4–9): control facial features and hair.
  • Fine codes (10–17): control colour, lighting, texture.

This disentanglement allows the model to preserve sketch structure while hallucinating realistic texture — something a plain decoder cannot do.

Why not a plain Pix2Pix?¶

Pix2Pix uses an adversarial discriminator, which adds training instability. Our setup uses L1 + LPIPS loss, which is stable, easier to tune, and has been shown to produce sharper results for sketch-to-face tasks.

Architecture diagram¶

Sketch (3×256×256)
    │
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│  GradualStyleEncoder        │
│  stem → stage1 → stage2     │
│       → stage3 → stage4     │
│  map_fine   → 8 style codes │
│  map_medium → 6 style codes │
│  map_coarse → 4 style codes │
└─────────────┬───────────────┘
              │  styles (18 × 512)
              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│  StyleGAN2Decoder           │
│  const (512×4×4)            │
│  → AdaIN blocks ×6          │
│  4→8→16→32→64→128→256       │
└─────────────┬───────────────┘
              │
              ▼
Face (3×256×256), range [-1,1]

Loss function: $$\mathcal{L} = \lambda_{L1} \cdot \|\hat{y} - y\|_1 + \lambda_{LPIPS} \cdot \text{LPIPS}(\hat{y}, y)$$

where $\lambda_{L1}=1.0$, $\lambda_{LPIPS}=0.8$.

# ── DEMO MODE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Set to True to run a quick smoke-test with synthetic data (< 1 min, no GPU needed).
# Set to False when you have real CelebA-HQ data and trained checkpoints.
DEMO_MODE = False

DEMO_BATCH   = 2      # batch size in demo
DEMO_BATCHES = 5      # batches per epoch in demo
DEMO_EPOCHS  = 2      # epochs in demo
DEMO_IMG_SZ  = 256     

if DEMO_MODE:
    import torch
    from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset

    def _make_demo_loaders(n=40, img_sz=DEMO_IMG_SZ, bs=DEMO_BATCH):
        """Tiny synthetic dataset: random tensors shaped like (sketch, face)."""
        sketches = torch.rand(n, 3, img_sz, img_sz)
        faces    = torch.rand(n, 3, img_sz, img_sz)
        ds = TensorDataset(sketches, faces)
        split = n // 5           # 20% val / test each
        train_n = n - 2 * split
        train_ds, val_ds, test_ds = torch.utils.data.random_split(
            ds, [train_n, split, split],
            generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(42))
        kw = dict(batch_size=bs, num_workers=0)
        return (
            torch.utils.data.DataLoader(train_ds, shuffle=True,  **kw),
            torch.utils.data.DataLoader(val_ds,   shuffle=False, **kw),
            torch.utils.data.DataLoader(test_ds,  shuffle=False, **kw),
        )

    print("[DEMO MODE] Using synthetic data — no CelebA-HQ needed.")
    print(f"            {DEMO_EPOCHS} epochs x {DEMO_BATCHES} batches, img_size={DEMO_IMG_SZ}")
else:
    print("[REAL MODE] Will load CelebA-HQ from cfg['data_root'].")

    print(f"Sketches already exist ({existing}), skipping generation.")
else:
    for img_path in img_dir.glob("*.jpg"):
        save_path = sketch_dir / img_path.name
        if save_path.exists():          # also skip individual already-done files
            continue
        img = cv2.imread(str(img_path), 0)
        edges = cv2.Canny(img, 100, 200)
        edges = 255 - edges
        cv2.imwrite(str(save_path), edges)

# ── Dataset ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if DEMO_MODE:
    train_loader, val_loader, test_loader = _make_demo_loaders()
    print(f"[DEMO] Train batches: {len(train_loader)} | "
          f"Val: {len(val_loader)} | Test: {len(test_loader)}")
else:
    DATA_ROOT = cfg["data_root"]   # change to your actual data path

    dataset = EdgeToFaceDataset(
        root=DATA_ROOT,
        img_size=256,
        augment=cfg["augment"],
    )

    seed_everything(cfg["seed"])
    val_size   = int(len(dataset) * cfg["val_split"])
    test_size  = int(len(dataset) * cfg["test_split"])
    train_size = len(dataset) - val_size - test_size

    train_ds, val_ds, test_ds = random_split(
        dataset,
        [train_size, val_size, test_size],
        generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(cfg["seed"]),
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=cfg["batch_size"], shuffle=True,
                              num_workers=cfg["num_workers"], pin_memory=True)
    val_loader   = DataLoader(val_ds,   batch_size=cfg["batch_size"], shuffle=False,
                              num_workers=cfg["num_workers"], pin_memory=True)
    test_loader  = DataLoader(test_ds,  batch_size=cfg["batch_size"], shuffle=False,
                              num_workers=cfg["num_workers"], pin_memory=True)

    print(f"Train: {len(train_ds)} | Val: {len(val_ds)} | Test: {len(test_ds)}")

# ── Training infra demo ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Demonstrates: AMP, grad clipping, grad norm logging, LR scheduler.
# In DEMO_MODE this actually runs DEMO_EPOCHS x DEMO_BATCHES — completes in seconds.

criterion = PspLoss(lambda_l1=cfg["lambda_l1"], lambda_lpips=cfg["lambda_lpips"]).to(DEVICE)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=cfg["lr"], weight_decay=cfg["weight_decay"])

_t_max    = DEMO_EPOCHS if DEMO_MODE else cfg["num_epochs"]
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=_t_max, eta_min=cfg["lr_min"])
scaler    = GradScaler(enabled=DEVICE.type == "cuda")

print("Components initialised:")
print(f"  Criterion  : {criterion.__class__.__name__}")
print(f"  Optimizer  : Adam (lr={cfg['lr']}, wd={cfg['weight_decay']})")
print(f"  Scheduler  : CosineAnnealingLR (T_max={_t_max}, eta_min={cfg['lr_min']})")
print(f"  AMP Scaler : enabled={DEVICE.type == 'cuda'}")
print(f"  Grad clip  : {cfg['grad_clip']}")

# ── Mini training loop demo ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
_epochs  = DEMO_EPOCHS  if DEMO_MODE else 1      # real mode: just 1 epoch for demo
_max_bat = DEMO_BATCHES if DEMO_MODE else 3       # cap batches

print(f"\nRunning {_epochs} demo epoch(s), max {_max_bat} batches each ...")
for epoch in range(1, _epochs + 1):
    model.train()
    running_loss, grad_norms = 0.0, []
    for batch_idx, (sketch, face) in enumerate(train_loader):
        if batch_idx >= _max_bat:
            break
        sketch, face = sketch.to(DEVICE), face.to(DEVICE)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast(enabled=DEVICE.type == "cuda"):
            pred = model(sketch)
            total_loss, loss_dict = criterion(pred, face)
            loss = total_loss

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        grad_norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), cfg["grad_clip"])
        grad_norms.append(grad_norm.item())
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()

    scheduler.step()
    avg_gn = sum(grad_norms) / max(len(grad_norms), 1)
    print(f"  Epoch {epoch}/{_epochs} | loss={loss.item():.4f} | "
          f"grad_norm={avg_gn:.3f} | lr={scheduler.get_last_lr()[0]:.2e}")

print("\nInfra demo complete. All Phase 3 training components verified:")
print("  [OK] Mixed precision (autocast + GradScaler)")
print("  [OK] Gradient clipping (clip_grad_norm_)")
print("  [OK] Grad norm logging")
print("  [OK] LR scheduler (CosineAnnealingLR)")

In [11]:
# ── Plot training curves from CSV log ────────────────────────────────────────
LOG_CSV = "experiments/logs/psp_v1_base/metrics.csv"

if Path(LOG_CSV).exists():
    epochs, train_loss, val_loss, lr, grad_norm = [], [], [], [], []
    with open(LOG_CSV) as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            epochs.append(int(row["epoch"]))
            train_loss.append(float(row.get("train_total_loss", 0)))
            val_loss.append(float(row.get("val_total_loss", 0)))
            lr.append(float(row.get("lr", 0)))
            grad_norm.append(float(row.get("train_grad_norm", 0)))

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 4))

    axes[0].plot(epochs, train_loss, label="Train Loss", color="#e74c3c")
    axes[0].plot(epochs, val_loss,   label="Val Loss",   color="#3498db", linestyle="--")
    axes[0].set_title("Train vs Validation Loss")
    axes[0].set_xlabel("Epoch"); axes[0].set_ylabel("Loss")
    axes[0].legend(); axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    axes[1].plot(epochs, lr, color="#2ecc71")
    axes[1].set_title("Learning Rate (CosineAnnealingLR)")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Epoch"); axes[1].set_ylabel("LR")
    axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    axes[2].plot(epochs, grad_norm, color="#9b59b6")
    axes[2].set_title("Gradient Norm per Epoch")
    axes[2].set_xlabel("Epoch"); axes[2].set_ylabel("Grad Norm")
    axes[2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig("reports/training_curves.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    print("Saved → reports/training_curves.png")
else:
    print(f"[Info] Log file not found at {LOG_CSV}. Run training first.")

In [17]:
# ── Plot training curves from CSV log ────────────────────────────────────────
LOG_CSV = "experiments/logs/ablation_unregularized/metrics.csv"

if Path(LOG_CSV).exists():
    epochs, train_loss, val_loss, lr, grad_norm = [], [], [], [], []
    with open(LOG_CSV) as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            epochs.append(int(row["epoch"]))
            train_loss.append(float(row.get("train_total_loss", 0)))
            val_loss.append(float(row.get("val_total_loss", 0)))
            lr.append(float(row.get("lr", 0)))
            grad_norm.append(float(row.get("train_grad_norm", 0)))

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 4))

    axes[0].plot(epochs, train_loss, label="Train Loss", color="#e74c3c")
    axes[0].plot(epochs, val_loss,   label="Val Loss",   color="#3498db", linestyle="--")
    axes[0].set_title("Train vs Validation Loss")
    axes[0].set_xlabel("Epoch"); axes[0].set_ylabel("Loss")
    axes[0].legend(); axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    axes[1].plot(epochs, lr, color="#2ecc71")
    axes[1].set_title("Learning Rate (CosineAnnealingLR)")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Epoch"); axes[1].set_ylabel("LR")
    axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    axes[2].plot(epochs, grad_norm, color="#9b59b6")
    axes[2].set_title("Gradient Norm per Epoch")
    axes[2].set_xlabel("Epoch"); axes[2].set_ylabel("Grad Norm")
    axes[2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig("reports/training_curves.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    print("Saved → reports/training_curves.png")
else:
    print(f"[Info] Log file not found at {LOG_CSV}. Run training first.")

    axes[0].plot(epochs, train_loss, label="Train Loss", color="#e74c3c")
    axes[0].plot(epochs, val_loss,   label="Val Loss",   color="#3498db", linestyle="--")
    axes[0].set_title("Train vs Validation Loss")
    axes[0].set_xlabel("Epoch"); axes[0].set_ylabel("Loss")
    axes[0].legend(); axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    axes[1].plot(epochs, lr, color="#2ecc71")
    axes[1].set_title("Learning Rate (CosineAnnealingLR)")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Epoch"); axes[1].set_ylabel("LR")
    axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    axes[2].plot(epochs, grad_norm, color="#9b59b6")
    axes[2].set_title("Gradient Norm per Epoch")
    axes[2].set_xlabel("Epoch"); axes[2].set_ylabel("Grad Norm")
    axes[2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig("reports/training_curves.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    print("Saved → reports/training_curves.png")
else:
    print(f"[Info] Log file not found at {LOG_CSV}. Run training first.")

# ── Load ablation logs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ABLATION_LOG_DIRS = {
    "Unregularized" : "experiments/logs/ablation_unregularized/metrics.csv",
    "Regularized"   : "experiments/logs/ablation_regularized/metrics.csv",
    "Normalized"    : "experiments/logs/ablation_normalized/metrics.csv",
}

def load_csv_log(path: str):
    data = {}
    if not Path(path).exists():
        return data
    with open(path) as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            for k, v in row.items():
                if k != "epoch":
                    data.setdefault(k, []).append(float(v))
    return data

ablation_logs = {name: load_csv_log(path) for name, path in ABLATION_LOG_DIRS.items()}
found = [k for k, v in ablation_logs.items() if v]
print(f"Loaded logs for: {found if found else 'None (run ablation training first)'}")

In [42]:
# ── Multi-seed evaluation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SEEDS = [42, 123, 999]
l1_criterion = nn.L1Loss()

psp_l1_scores = []
psp_times     = []

for seed in SEEDS:
    ckpt_path = f"experiments/checkpoints/psp_seed{seed}/best.pt"

    if Path(ckpt_path).exists():
        _img_sz   = DEMO_IMG_SZ if DEMO_MODE else 256
        seed_model = pSp(img_size=_img_sz).to(DEVICE).eval()
        ckpt = torch.load(ckpt_path, map_location=DEVICE)
        seed_model.load_state_dict(ckpt["model_state"])

        total_l1, n_batches, t0 = 0.0, 0, time.time()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for sketch, face in test_loader:
                sketch, face = sketch.to(DEVICE), face.to(DEVICE)
                pred = seed_model(sketch)
                total_l1 += l1_criterion(pred, face).item()
                n_batches += 1

        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        avg_l1  = total_l1 / max(n_batches, 1)
        psp_l1_scores.append(avg_l1)
        psp_times.append(elapsed)
        print(f"Seed {seed}: Test L1 = {avg_l1:.4f} | Eval time = {elapsed:.1f}s")

    elif DEMO_MODE:
        # No checkpoint yet — run a quick forward pass on demo test set to show the pipeline
        seed_everything(seed)
        _img_sz = DEMO_IMG_SZ if DEMO_MODE else 256
        seed_model = pSp(img_size=_img_sz).to(DEVICE).eval()  # untrained weights
        total_l1, n_batches, t0 = 0.0, 0, time.time()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for sketch, face in test_loader:
                sketch, face = sketch.to(DEVICE), face.to(DEVICE)
                pred = seed_model(sketch)
                total_l1 += l1_criterion(pred, face).item()
                n_batches += 1
        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        avg_l1  = total_l1 / max(n_batches, 1)
        psp_l1_scores.append(avg_l1)
        psp_times.append(elapsed)
        print(f"[DEMO] Seed {seed}: L1 = {avg_l1:.4f} (untrained — for pipeline demo only)")

    else:
        psp_l1_scores.append(None)
        print(f"Seed {seed}: checkpoint not found — run training with seed={seed}")

valid_scores = [s for s in psp_l1_scores if s is not None]
if valid_scores:
    psp_mean = np.mean(valid_scores)
    psp_std  = np.std(valid_scores)
    suffix   = " (untrained demo)" if DEMO_MODE and not Path(BEST_CKPT).exists() else ""
    print(f"\npSp — Mean L1: {psp_mean:.4f} ± {psp_std:.4f}{suffix}")
else:
    psp_mean, psp_std = None, None
    print("\npSp results unavailable — run training first.")

if psp_mean is not None:
    improve = (mlp_l1 - psp_mean) / mlp_l1 * 100
    print(f"{'pSp (Phase 3)':<16} {f'{psp_mean:.4f} ± {psp_std:.4f}':>22} {psp_params:>12,} {'CNN':>10}")
    print("─" * 65)
    print(f"Improvement vs MLP: {improve:+.1f}%")
    if psp_mean < mlp_l1:
        print("✓ pSp beats the MLP baseline.")
    else:
        print("✗ pSp does not yet beat the MLP baseline — continue training.")
else:
    print(f"{'pSp (Phase 3)':<16} {'Pending training':>22} {psp_params:>12,} {'CNN':>10}")
print("═" * 65)

# ── Comparison bar chart ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))

models = ["MLP (Phase 2)"]
means  = [mlp_l1]
stds   = [mlp_std]
colors = ["#95a5a6"]

if psp_mean is not None:
    models.append("pSp (Phase 3)")
    means.append(psp_mean)
    stds.append(psp_std)
    colors.append("#2ecc71" if psp_mean < mlp_l1 else "#e74c3c")

bars = ax.bar(models, means, yerr=stds, color=colors, capsize=6,
              edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.85)

for bar, mean in zip(bars, means):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height() + 0.005,
            f"{mean:.4f}", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")

ax.set_ylabel("Test L1 Loss (lower is better)", fontsize=12)
ax.set_title("pSp vs MLP Baseline Comparison", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold")
ax.set_ylim(0, max(means) * 1.3)
ax.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
Path("reports").mkdir(exist_ok=True)

Task 6 — CNN Visualization¶

Three visualization types (CNN track requirement):

  1. First-layer filter visualization
  2. Intermediate feature maps
  3. Grad-CAM saliency maps

print(f"Prediction shape    : {sample_pred.shape}")
